Original Requirements: Build the Volopa OOP (Out-of-Pocket) Expenses API System covering User Management, Pocket Expense CSV Batch Upload, and Single Expense Data Capturing with role hierarchy, permission delegation, CSV batch upload with all-or-nothing validation, and single expense CRUD with FX conversion.
Product Goals: Create a secure multi-tenant expense management system with granular RBAC
Provide reliable CSV batch upload with synchronous validation and error handling
Implement intelligent FX conversion with real-time rates and client commission adjustments
User Stories: As a Primary Administrator, I want to grant management rights to Administrators so they can manage specific users' expenses
As an Administrator, I want to upload CSV files with up to 200 expense records and receive immediate validation feedback
As a Business User, I want to create single expenses with automatic FX conversion based on my wallet's base currency
As a Card User, I want to see my expense approval status and receive notifications when expenses are processed
As any user, I want to override system-calculated FX amounts when I have receipts with different exchange rates
Competitive Analysis: Expensify: Strong mobile app, receipt scanning, but limited role management granularity
SAP Concur: Enterprise-grade with complex approval workflows, but heavy UI and steep learning curve
Rydoo: Good CSV import features and multi-currency support, but lacks granular permission delegation
Zoho Expense: Affordable with basic role management, but limited FX conversion capabilities
Receipt Bank: Excellent document processing, but weak expense approval workflow
Chrome River: Strong compliance features, but poor user experience for bulk uploads
Certify: Good integration capabilities, but limited multi-tenant architecture

Requirement Analysis: The system requires a sophisticated multi-tenant architecture with granular role-based access control. The permission system uses user_feature_permission table for fine-grained control, allowing Primary Admins to delegate management rights to Administrators who can then manage specific user subsets. The CSV upload feature demands synchronous all-or-nothing validation to ensure data integrity, processing up to 200 rows with 14+ columns including complex validation rules for dates, currencies, and expense types. The FX conversion system requires real-time rate fetching with 30-day lookback, client-specific commission adjustments, and user override capabilities. All endpoints must be protected by Oauth2UserClient middleware with proper JSON response formatting via Laravel API Resources.
Requirement Pool: Implement role hierarchy (Primary Administrator, Administrator, Business User, Card User) with user_feature_permission RBAC system and permission delegation capabilities
Build CSV batch upload endpoint with synchronous all-or-nothing validation for max 200 rows, supporting 14 columns with complex validation rules for dates, currencies, expense types
Create single expense CRUD operations with status workflow (draft → submitted → approved → rejected) and pocket_expense_metadata for flexible categorization
Implement FX conversion system with debounced API calls, 30-day lookback for dated rates, client commission adjustments, and user override functionality
Develop expense source management with 3 default sources, global 'Other' option, and max 20 active sources per client with soft delete capability
UI Design draft: RESTful API endpoints with no UI components. JSON response structure includes: authentication via Oauth2UserClient middleware, consistent error formatting with HTTP status codes (200, 201, 204, 422), API Resources for response transformation, structured validation errors with line_number/field/error/value for CSV uploads, and pagination support for expense listing endpoints. All responses follow Laravel API Resource patterns with data/meta/links structure.
